text: player
Fu Ji
{var:player_nickname}, I heard that Osamu Saitou appointed you as the inspector for the soft opening. I bet your feedback on the rides is very important to him.
Yes, there is such a thing... I was just thinking of going somewhere cool to fill out the survey.
Good, now hurry up and write a comment for me. There aren't enough mahjong dojos on the island.
Oh, that's a good one. Leave that to me.
Cynthia
I think some improvements can be made in terms of how far the attractions are from each other and the transport tools that can be used to go to them. Even adults would get tired, let alone children.
I see... Cynthia, you're so considerate.
Kaavi
I hope that next time they will offer more than just open-air stalls.
That makes sense... Oh, Kaavi, when did you get here?
Yuzu
Argh, security! The security system needs to be better, especially to target dishonest and deceitful behavior!
For some reason, this piece of advice seems to be very specific, but... I guess it's still a valid suggestion.
Leia
Hehe, I suggest that they enhance the network signal in the amusement park so that the children will definitely receive messages from their teacher.
...Leia, did you see how quickly they left? Maybe it has nothing to do with whether they received the messages or the signal...
Wait a minute, why is everyone from the beach coming here suddenly?!

When I wasn't paying attention, the people who were playing on the beach started gathering around me to discuss their experiences here at the amusement park. So many opinions come pouring in that I suddenly don't know what to write...

That being said, new things always need to be explored, and it's better to receive all sorts of comments than silence. Whether they are giving praise or criticizing something, everyone's feedback has one thing in common.
With this thought in mind, I glance at the people who are actively sharing their experiences and write my first sentence on the feedback form--
"I look forward to seeing a new and improved amusement park island next time."
